Doth not the Lord restrain the wrath of man, and make the remainder thereof praise him ?

Job's Reply to Bildad's Third Speech Job impatiently breaks off Bildad's speech. He is just as aware of God's might as is Bildad, and can speak of it at least as eloquently. 26:5 Shades: the shadowy spirits of the dead. The underworld is sometimes imagined as being not merely under the earth but under the water that is beneath the earth (Ps. 136:6).
quotes.speaker: Raymond P. Scheindlin
quotes.attr: Raymond P. Scheindlin, The Book of Job, W. W. Norton & Company New York, 1998, pp 201
